verdict.rationale: The only production-monitoring evidence is a marketing line that agents can be 'configured, deployed and monitored'. Documented analysis features (success evaluation, sentiment, conversation search, turning underperforming calls into tests) all run after the fact on completed conversations. Missing for 10: live in-call monitoring, alerting on agent misbehavior, error-rate metrics or spike alerts, integration with external observability or paging tools, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
